translations.web: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’
translations.bsb: So now we call the arrogant blessed. Not only do evildoers prosper, they even test God and escape.’”
translations.kjv: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, they that tempt God are even delivered.
